mapper.select: select * from yc_activity_home_version where status='draft' and publish_mode='scheduled' and publish_at is not null and publish_at<=sysdate() and del_flag='0' order by publish_at asc
mapper.update: update yc_activity_home_version set status='published',published_by='scheduler',published_time=sysdate() where version_id=#{versionId} and status='draft'
